name: PDF
description: Merge, split, and reorganize PDFs in your browser.

pdf-merge.name: Merge PDFs
pdf-merge.description: Combine several PDFs into one, in the order you choose — on your device.

pdf-split.name: Extract Pages
pdf-split.description: Pull a page selection out of a PDF into a new file — on your device.

pdf-rotate.name: Rotate PDF
pdf-rotate.description: Turn all pages or a selection by 90, 180, or 270 degrees — on your device.

pdf-delete.name: Delete Pages
pdf-delete.description: Remove unwanted pages and keep the rest — on your device.

pdf-reorder.name: Reorder Pages
pdf-reorder.description: Rearrange a PDF's pages into a new order — on your device.

pdf-watermark.name: Watermark PDF
pdf-watermark.description: Stamp diagonal text across every page — on your device.

pdf-pagenum.name: Number Pages
pdf-pagenum.description: Add n / total page numbers to every page — on your device.

pdf-metadata.name: PDF Metadata
pdf-metadata.description: See a document's title, author, dates, and producer — nothing leaves your device.

pdf-split-size.name: Split by Size
pdf-split-size.description: Break a PDF into parts that each stay under a target file size — on your device.

pdf-metadata-edit.name: Edit PDF Metadata
pdf-metadata-edit.description: Change a document's title, author, subject, and keywords, then save — on your device.

images-to-pdf.name: Images to PDF
images-to-pdf.description: Combine JPG, PNG, and WebP images into one PDF, in the order you choose — on your device.

pdf-reverse.name: Reverse Pages
pdf-reverse.description: Flip a PDF so the last page comes first — on your device.

pdf-duplicate.name: Duplicate Pages
pdf-duplicate.description: Repeat chosen pages in place — on your device.

pdf-crop.name: Crop PDF
pdf-crop.description: Trim an even margin off every page — on your device.

pdf-nup.name: Pages per Sheet (N-up)
pdf-nup.description: Fit 2, 4, 6, or 9 pages onto each sheet to save paper — on your device.

pdf-blank.name: Add Blank Page
pdf-blank.description: Insert an empty page anywhere in a PDF — on your device.

pdf-split-half.name: Split Pages in Half
pdf-split-half.description: Turn two-page-spread scans into single pages — on your device.

pdf-flatten.name: Flatten Form
pdf-flatten.description: Bake filled form fields into the page so they can't be edited — on your device.

pdf-to-images.name: PDF to Images
pdf-to-images.description: Turn each page into a PNG or JPEG and download them as a ZIP — on your device.

pdf-to-text.name: PDF to Text
pdf-to-text.description: Pull the readable text out of a PDF — on your device.

pdf-remove-blank.name: Remove Blank Pages
pdf-remove-blank.description: Find and drop empty pages, great for cleaning up scans — on your device.

pdf-protect.name: Protect PDF
pdf-protect.description: Add a password with 256-bit encryption so only people with the password can open it — on your device.

pdf-unlock.name: Unlock PDF
pdf-unlock.description: Remove a password you know from a PDF so it opens freely — on your device.

pdf-compress.name: Compress PDF
pdf-compress.description: Rebuild a PDF with tighter internal structure to shrink its size — on your device.

pdf-repair.name: Repair PDF
pdf-repair.description: Rebuild a damaged PDF into a clean, readable copy — on your device.

pdf-linearize.name: Optimize for Web
pdf-linearize.description: Linearize a PDF for fast web view, so it opens page-by-page — on your device.

pdf-sanitize.name: Sanitize PDF
pdf-sanitize.description: Strip unreferenced, hidden content and rebuild a clean file — on your device.

pdf-extract-images.name: Extract Images
pdf-extract-images.description: Pull every embedded picture out of a PDF at full resolution — on your device.

pdf-extract-attachments.name: Extract Attachments
pdf-extract-attachments.description: Save files embedded inside a PDF back to your device.

pdf-ocr.name: OCR — Make Searchable
pdf-ocr.description: Read the text in a scanned PDF and add an invisible, searchable text layer — on your device.

pdf-edit.name: Edit PDF
pdf-edit.description: Highlight, underline, draw shapes, add notes, freehand, and truly redact — one editor, on your device.

pdf-fill-form.name: Fill Form
pdf-fill-form.description: Type into a PDF's form fields and download the completed file — on your device.

pdf-split-bookmarks.name: Split by Bookmarks
pdf-split-bookmarks.description: Split a PDF into one file per top-level bookmark (chapter) — on your device.

ui.dropTitle: Drop a PDF here, or click to choose
ui.dropTitleMany: Drop PDFs here, or click to choose
ui.dropMore: Drop another PDF, or click to add more
ui.dropHint: Files are processed right here — nothing is uploaded.
ui.rangeHint: Use page numbers and ranges, like 1-3, 7, 12- (this file has {count}).
ui.rangeInvalid: That selection doesn't match this document's pages.
ui.deleteAllInvalid: That would delete every page — a PDF needs at least one.
ui.mergeNeedTwo: Add at least two PDFs to merge.
ui.mergeAction: Merge into one PDF ({count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}})
ui.splitAction: Extract {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}
ui.rotateAction: Rotate {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} & download
ui.deleteAction: Delete {removed, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}, keep {kept}
ui.errorLoad: Couldn't open that file as a PDF. It may be corrupted or password-protected.
ui.errorSave: Couldn't produce the new PDF. The file may use features this tool can't rewrite.
ui.privacy: Your documents never leave this device — everything happens in your browser.
ui.metaNone: This document carries no metadata — that's often intentional.
ui.splitSizeNote: Each part downloads separately as soon as it's ready.
ui.i2pDropTitle: Drop images here, or click to choose
ui.i2pDropMore: Drop more images, or click to add
ui.i2pDropHint: JPG, PNG, and WebP — arrange them in the order you want.
ui.dupAction: Duplicate {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} & download
ui.cropNote: Trims the visible area evenly on all sides — the underlying content is untouched, so it can be restored.
ui.blankHint: 0 puts it first; {count} puts it last.
ui.flattenFields: {count, plural, =0 {No form fields} one {# form field} other {# form fields}}
ui.flattenNone: This PDF has no fillable form fields to flatten.
ui.flattenNote: Flattening keeps how the form looks but makes the values permanent.
ui.p2iAction: Convert {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} & download ZIP
ui.p2iError: Couldn't render this PDF — it may be corrupted or password-protected.
ui.p2tHint: Works on PDFs that contain real text. A scanned image won't have any to extract.
ui.rbHint: Higher removes pages with a little stray content too; lower keeps anything but truly empty pages.
ui.rbRemoved: Removed {count, plural, one {# blank page} other {# blank pages}}
ui.rbAllBlank: Every page looked blank — nothing was removed.
ui.protectHint: Anyone opening the file will need this exact password. There's no way to recover it if lost.
ui.unlockDropTitle: Drop a password-protected PDF, or click to choose
ui.unlockDropHint: You'll need the password it was locked with.
ui.unlockError: Wrong password, or this PDF isn't encrypted.
ui.unlockNote: Only works when you already know the password — this doesn't crack protection.
ui.compressNote: Optimizes the file's structure and stream compression. It doesn't downscale images, so image-heavy PDFs may shrink only a little.
ui.repairError: Could not repair this file. It may be too damaged to recover.
ui.repairNote: Rebuilds the document structure. Files that are only partly damaged usually recover; badly corrupted files may not.
ui.linNote: Reorders the file so a browser can show the first page before the whole PDF downloads.
ui.sanitizeNote: Removes objects the document does not reference, then rebuilds a clean copy.
ui.extractImagesError: Could not read images from this file.
ui.extractImagesEmpty: No embedded images found in this PDF.
ui.extractAttachError: Could not read attachments from this file.
ui.ocrIntro: Best for scanned pages or images of text. Adds a hidden text layer so you can search and copy — the page still looks the same.
ui.ocrError: Could not read text from this PDF.
ui.ocrWords: {count, plural, one {# word found} other {# words found}}
ui.ocrNoText: No readable text was found. This works best on scanned documents, not blank or photo-only pages.
ui.editRedactNote: Redaction permanently removes the covered text and images from the file — not just hides them.
ui.fillNoFields: This PDF has no fillable form fields.
ui.fillFlatten: Flatten (lock fields so they can't be changed)
ui.splitBmIntro: Uses the PDF's own bookmarks (outline) to cut it into sections — one file per top-level bookmark.
ui.splitBmNone: This PDF has no bookmarks to split by.
ui.splitBmDone: Split into {count} files and downloaded as a .zip.
